purpose: Fresh U3 reserve after the I repair and bounded complete-message fallback, frozen before its first production export or model generation.
evaluationOrder: Preserve first-run inputs and outputs. Judge production readiness and the semantic criteria independently before any repair.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: A sendable draft for each contentful request, addressed to the named person when one is stated, retaining every supplied fact, uncertainty, status, condition, negation, amount, unit, and exact literal. Source-free requests must safely ask for missing source rather than invent a message.
semanticCriteria.critical: A copied writer instruction, omitted recipient, altered status or temporal relationship, lost condition or negation, changed amount or unit, altered protected literal, invented content, or a source-free request marked ready.
semanticCriteria.minor: Style or grammar changes that preserve all supplied meaning.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 14 contentful cases must be review-ready with zero critical meaning errors and both source-free cases must be rejected before review.
